new_scholarship.description: The second of the five editais opened by the Managing Committee of Fiocruz for the 2027 activity year. This call covers the CAPES-Global.Edu modality Capacitacao de curta duracao no Exterior, short-term training abroad. Unlike the sandwich-doctorate call, it is open not only to Fiocruz master's and doctoral students registered on Sucupira but also to Fiocruz teaching staff, researchers and technical staff who hold a formal employment relationship (CLT or statutory) with the institution and are involved in graduate-programme activities. The purpose is individual qualification and institutional strengthening through technical, scientific or pedagogical training courses abroad, expressly excluding language training. Each candidate may register for only one of the five Fiocruz editais, and multiple registrations are automatically voided.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: People formally linked to Fiocruz: (a) teaching staff, researchers and technical professionals with a formal (CLT or statutory) employment relationship with Fundacao Oswaldo Cruz who support graduate-programme teaching, research, extension and internationalisation activities, and (b) master's or doctoral students duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as students of a Fiocruz graduate programme. In both cases the candidate's graduate programme must be linked to the CAPES Global network's strategic themes listed in Annex I.
